female.sp: Heindree Sturm, Grassley Defense Systems combat variant. Use the attached official full-body reference as mechanical design authority. Preserve the cool medium-gray armor, dark indigo-violet structural sections, magenta optical sensor, the twin large circular shoulder mechanisms enclosed by squared outer armor blocks, angular chest plate, round hip and knee discs, and long narrow lower legs. Her LEFT forearm carries the very large tall rectangular shield with the pale gray central face and dark gray border; keep the entire shield inside frame. Her RIGHT hand holds the long dedicated dark beam rifle with its extended barrel; keep the whole rifle inside frame. Preserve the compact backpack and the single long vertically stowed beam-saber handle rising behind her RIGHT shoulder, without turning it into an antenna or extra weapon. Translate the magenta forehead sensor into a compact practical hair ornament while leaving a fully human face unobstructed; no Gundam V-fin. Keep substantial shoulder blocks, forearm armor and round knee armor while the open fitted design exposes collarbone, waist flanks and upper-thigh gaps between plates. Front-facing full-body portrait with face, torso, shield, rifle and both feet visible with generous margins. Pose otherwise freely chosen. No letters, insignia, logos or background text. Face distinction: a very tall Slavic woman in her twenties with a long wide angular face, medium almond eyes with upturned outer corners, an aquiline nose, thin lips, strong jaw, pale skin, and short thick navy asymmetric hair with asymmetric bangs. Do not resemble the pilot or any previous character.
